extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: 5.10.562: The Aura sources page shows its ratings whole (no chip cut at the panel edge) and the plot in Arabic when the metadata language is Arabic. 5.10.561: NAS section titles play their NAS file directly from the title page, with the NAS file listed in Sources. 5.10.560: The Aura sources theme (default); IPTV films and series open the title page and play the provider file directly, with it listed in Sources; Xtream VOD plays again; DexWorld lists and playback from the provider when its server is blocked; Info on server Continue Watching items; a new default look. 5.10.559: Usenet on Apple TV: the engine now lives inside the Dex Hub Apple TV app itself, and the engine add-on starts it when a Usenet source is picked. 5.10.558: Usenet as a source of its own: your NNTP provider and Newznab indexers (Settings, Sources, Usenet), played on this device through a separate engine program (Mac and CoreELEC). 5.10.557: the source filter as a side panel with TRaSH Guides chips, the sources come back when nothing plays, EasyNews as a source, a subtitle from a file.
